# spo_blocked_page_content_type (Data Source)

Look up an existing BlockedPageContentType object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `content_type` (String) The blocked content type (echoes identity).
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
